_note: v0.27.0 (plan v0.27.0-dsuite-p0a §B) SSR contract otp-input@1 (ADR 0012): td_otp_input() prints by default a NATIVE OTP field (`div.td-otp` + label + `input.td-otp__input` with name / value / required / maxlength=6 / pattern / inputmode=numeric / autocomplete=one-time-code — works without JS); element mode (`element => true` or Td::configure ssr_elements) wraps the same field in `<td-otp-input data-td-ssr="otp-input@1">` + the 6 decorative cells, adopted IN PLACE by <td-otp-input>. Shared by test/php/td-ssr-otp-copy.test.js (PHP output) and src/form/td-otp-input.ssr.engines.browser-test.js (Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, via test/ssr/fixtures/otp.html — GENERATED by `node test/ssr/build-otp-copy-fixture.mjs`; the PHP test fails when it is stale). `expect`: the state the hydrated element must hold (value, control id, label text, required / disabled / readonly, error text). `dropped`: `attrs` entries that must reach neither the host nor the input (owned `name` / `value` in `attrs` are reserved: the host name and the value stay the helper's).
